path_filter.description: Regex filter on result file paths (e.g. ^src/ or \.(go|ts)$)

mode.description: compact: signatures+metadata (default). full: with source. files: just file list.

context.description: Lines of context around each match (like grep -C). Only used in compact mode.

limit.description: Max enriched results per call. Default 10. Response includes 'total_grep_matches' and 'total_results' so callers can detect truncation. No offset parameter — raise limit or narrow with file_pattern / path_filter to see more.
